decision.explanation: The question asks for the owner of the portrait. Document D1 explicitly states Wilhelm Wöhrl is the 'owner' (D1S15). Document D2 states the portrait has a 'permanent home' within the 'Fondation Custodia' collection (D2S3), implying institutional ownership/custody. Pieter Christoffel Wonder is the artist (D1S9, D2S2), not the owner. Frits Lugt is the collector who assembled the collection (D2S5) but the current entity holding the work is the Fondation Custodia. Other candidates like 'the ironmonger' or 'Lugt' are either aliases or historical figures not currently identified as the owner in the text.
